data.name: Fairyland Journey
data.detailed_description:
🎮 Game Features (遊戲特色)

Classic turn-based combat mode for fast-paced strategy and intense offense/defense showdowns.

Zero-fuss, short bursts, fast tempo. Exquisitely crafted models, rich fairy tale characters, plus gorgeous combat effects, full of detail.

Hundreds of unique Eudemons (Mythical Beasts) await your command. Master the use of Mystic Treasures, leverage elemental advantages, and synergize skills to forge your ultimate, strongest lineup!

Make every battle an extreme thrill and bring you an ultra-satisfying combat experience!

Move your fingers, engage your mind! Come and have a battle that belongs to you!

【Game Features】

🐾 Warm Companionship from Cute Pets: Adventure is Never Lonely with Them!

Adventure is never a lonely journey for one; you'll have more strength with them by your side! Super adorable pets like the Snow Yeti, Shark Sauce, Wolf Red Cap, and more make their grand appearance. They will light up your path in the silent night, and fight alongside you when you're in danger!

✨ Getting Strong is Easy! Enjoy the Game Even if You're Not a Strategy Expert!

Simply set up your strategic formation, and the auto-battle system frees up your hands, with strategic commands available for you to take over at any time. Effortlessly advance the plot during commutes or work breaks!

⚔️ Diverse Skill Synergy, Endless Combat Fun

In Hall Competitions, you will experience infinite possibilities of skill combinations. Each Eudemon possesses unique and powerful skills, and your role as a Trainer is to cleverly pair them and formulate the best tactics. Whether it's tackling formidable foes or achieving victory in PvP arenas, use exquisite skill combinations to overcome your opponents.

🌟 Multiple Adorable Eudemons, Evolving and Fusing into a Thousand Forms

In this world, hundreds of Eudemons await your discovery. Even more excitingly, each Eudemon has unique potential. You can freely choose their growth path according to your preferences and tactical needs, creating a powerful team that is uniquely yours.
